purpose: Comparison placement only; not exact source geometry or a game-ready assembly
allowedTransform: positive uniform scale, Z yaw, XY translation, source z-min anchoring
sourceFrame: Blender world coordinates from common-frame source GLBs; Z up

search.xyPlacement: exact rotated generated vertex bbox center to source vertex bbox center

limitations: One-way surface score cannot prove source coverage or preserve missing wings.
Symmetric geometry may leave yaw ambiguous; candidate scores are reported.
No mirror, nonuniform scale, vertex edits, seam repair or per-mesh repositioning.
No architectural accuracy, courtyard clearance, topology or gameplay acceptance implied.

sourceSeamCaps.handling: Source GLB used as-is; no caps appended or double-counted.
